description: Converts files (PDFs, images) to markdown via vision LLM

conversionTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for the conversion to complete in milliseconds
conversionTimeoutMs.title: Timeout

resizeImagePx.description: Maximum dimension to resize images to before sending to vision model
resizeImagePx.title: Image Size

convert.label: Convert to Markdown
convert.description: Converts an image or PDF from the work directory to markdown with the vision model.

file.title: File
file.description: Path of the image or PDF, relative to the work directory. Supports {{template}} expressions.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Instructions replacing the default OCR prompt (e.g. what to extract). Supports {{template}} expressions.

output.title: Save as
output.description: Optional path (relative to the work directory) to also write the markdown to. Supports {{template}} expressions.
